Name: Antisocial Farm
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
[size=3]keep those pesky neighbours and local hooligans away with a vast, deep, maybe shark-infested, definitely polluted, anti-friendship moat[/size]


[b]- features -[/b]

[list]
[*] replaces [b]fishing [/b]farm by default (configurable)
[*]comes with custom strings on signposts and things
[*]lights that come on at night
[*]seasonal pet house
[*]all grass is tillable
[*]just a massive empty island space for farming
[/list]

[b]- installation -[/b]

1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿
2. unzip mod folder into [code]stardew valley/mods
[/code]3. run the game with smapi and start a new save on the fishing farm
